notes: An obby, with the shape answer choosing a very long flat course that keeps going, so course-flat and the Classic Obby preset, and P6 as always for this genre. The second answer names the obstacle mix outright, so I added the rows it maps to on top of the preset: obstacle-climb for the wallhops and tightropes, obstacle-timing for disappearing platforms, obstacle-moving for moving platforms and conveyors, with obstacle-jump kept because 'don't just make it jumps' asks for more than jumps rather than none. Wallhops are a glitch-obby technique that the P6 generator cannot validate — they exploit undocumented Humanoid state timing rather than the documented jump limits — so the critical path should stay inside the standard 11-stud and 7.2-stud spacing and the wallhop sections be treated as author-supplied. Nothing said where the course ends, so I assumed a finish at the far end, which is what winner-zone places; tiger theming is dressing on the same course.
